newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July industrial output up revised 4.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan July industrial output up revised 4.9 pct.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in July increased a revised 4.9 percent from the previous month, compared with a preliminary estimate of a 4.1 percent increase, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.
Industrial production increased a revised 6.0 percent from a year earlier, against a preliminary estimate of a 5.3 percent increase.

A ministry official told a briefing that industrial output in the July-September quarter was seen up a revised 1.9 percent quarter-on-quarter, and up 4.1 percent year-on-year.
